		state_target = yes
		on_map_mode = map_only
		targets = { 65 }
		targets_dynamic = no
		target_root_trigger = { tag = FRA }
		target_trigger = {
			FROM = {
				is_owned_by = ROOT
				NOT = { is_core_of = ROOT }
			}
			SAX = { exists = no }
			FROM = { is_core_of = SAX }

		cost = 10
		state_target = yes
		on_map_mode = map_only
		target_root_trigger = { tag = FRA }
		target_trigger = {
			FROM = {
				is_owned_by = ROOT
				NOT = { is_core_of = ROOT }
			}
			SIE = {
				exists = yes
				NOT = { has_war_with = ROOT }
			}
			FROM = { OR = { is_core_of = SIE is_claimed_by = SIE } }
		}
		complete_effect = {
			SIE = { transfer_state = FROM }
		}
		ai_will_do = {
			factor = 0
			modifier = {
				add = 6
				SIE = {
					OR = {
						is_in_faction_with = ROOT
						is_subject_of = ROOT
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	LR_dec_settle_revive_sie = {
		icon = generic_civil_support
		cost = 25
		state_target = yes
		on_map_mode = map_only
		targets = { 700 }
		targets_dynamic = no
		target_root_trigger = { tag = FRA }
		target_trigger = {
			FROM = {
				is_owned_by = ROOT
				NOT = { is_core_of = ROOT }
			}
			SIE = { exists = no }
			FROM = { is_core_of = SIE }
		}
		complete_effect = {
			release_puppet = SIE
			FROM = { set_state_flag = LR_settle_keep }
			every_state = {
				limit = {
					is_owned_by = SIE
					NOT = { has_state_flag = LR_settle_keep }
				}
				ROOT = { transfer_state = PREV }
			}
			FROM = { clr_state_flag = LR_settle_keep }
			SIE = { lr_fra_name_puppet = yes }
		}
		ai_will_do = {
			factor = 4
		}
	}
